slides.headline: She arrived in the US at 21 with little money, working as a stadium food server to pay for school. Forbes just named her one of the world's top innovators at 53.
Yamini Rangan, CEO of HubSpot, was named to Forbes' 2026 '50 Over 50' Innovation list
slides.body: The sixth annual list, produced by Forbes with Mika Brzezinski's Know Your Value initiative, honours 200 women across four categories - Rangan featured among the Innovation honourees.

slides.headline: She completed her engineering degree at Bharathiar University before earning an MBA at UC Berkeley.
slides.body: After working customer-facing roles at SAP, Workday and Dropbox, she became HubSpot's CEO in 2021, guiding the software company past $3 billion in annual revenue.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when its engineering graduates end up leading billion-dollar global software companies.
slides.body: Rangan's path from an Indian engineering degree to a stadium food-service job to a Fortune-recognized CEO shows Indian technical training compounding into leadership decades later.
